notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Reach the organization with a relevant operational question.
intro: A proposed B2B growth workbench for Ease Health: segment provider organizations, identify an operational buyer and compare channels on qualified conversations.
queueIntro: Research organizations and administrative workflows. These examples contain no patient records, clinical profiles or individual health information.
workbenchIntro: Check organizational fit, decision ownership and evidence before preparing a campaign. A provider’s service category does not establish an operational pain point.
firstBody: Connect a behavioral health organization’s operating model with a relevant CRM, EHR or billing discovery question. Keep inferred needs separate from confirmed customer statements.

fields.label: Operational question grounded in a source
Unsubstantiated clinical or financial outcome claim
Outbound owner and follow-up path recorded

rules.title: Verify the organization segment
rules.next: Confirm the organization provides the relevant services; do not target individuals based on health information.

rules.title: Remove the unsupported outcome claim
rules.next: A campaign must not promise clinical results or reimbursement gains without appropriate support.

rules.title: Find the operational decision owner
rules.next: Identify the person responsible for the administrative process, not a patient or clinical profile.

rules.title: Ground the discovery question
rules.next: Use a source about the organization’s operations and label anything not confirmed.

rules.title: Research before personalization
rules.next: Treat the proposed pain point as a question. Do not write it as a known fact about the provider.

rules.title: Assign the follow-up path
rules.next: The campaign needs an owner for replies, stop requests and qualified conversations.

ready.title: Ready for B2B campaign review
ready.next: A reviewer can inspect the organization, operational question, evidence and follow-up owner. Public signals remain hypotheses until discovery confirms the need.

records.name: Alder Behavioral Group
records.context: The operations lead describes separate intake and billing tools.
records.question: Where does information need to be re-entered between teams?

records.name: Cedar Recovery Network
records.context: A public expansion suggests additional administrative coordination.
records.question: How will new locations share administrative workflows?

records.name: Birch Care Partners
records.context: The researcher assumes the organization needs a new EHR.
records.question: Which administrative process is actually creating friction?

records.name: Willow Wellness Group
records.context: A source describes expansion but the administrative buyer is unknown.
records.question: Who owns platform evaluation across locations?

records.name: Juniper Services
records.context: The draft promises a financial improvement that has not been demonstrated.
records.question: What supported operational question can replace the promise?

records.name: Elm Behavioral Partners
records.context: Research is useful but reply ownership is not assigned.
records.question: Who will receive and qualify campaign replies?

metricsTitle: Measure qualified conversations, not just form fills.
metricsIntro: A fixed synthetic account cohort separates campaign response from a held, qualified sales conversation.
metricsNotes: Qualified opportunities require an agreed organizational need and a legitimate next step. A form fill is not automatically qualified.
Keep the initial account cohort and observation window fixed when comparing channels.
These invented figures describe B2B marketing only, not patient outcomes, claims processing or actual Ease performance.

experiments.name: Operationally specific landing page
experiments.hypothesis: A clear administrative workflow attracts more relevant discovery.
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Relevant follow-up context
experiments.hypothesis: A reviewed operational brief helps the receiving seller ask a useful question.
experiments.treatment: Organization context, source and next question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Choose one provider segment
roadmap.body: Define organization-level fit, source quality, buyer roles and qualification with sales.

roadmap.title: Connect channel to outcome
roadmap.body: Instrument campaign, meeting and opportunity stages; test one landing-page message with a clear denominator.

roadmap.title: Improve the repeatable path
roadmap.body: Refine targeting and handoffs using sales feedback. Expand only after a complete observation window.
